Class SecurityNoticeService

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.service.SecurityNoticeService
@Service public class SecurityNoticeService extends Object
Delivers credential mail only after its transaction commits, without making mail availability a prerequisite.

    • credentialChanged

      public void credentialChanged(User user, String eventKey, Object... args)
      Announces a change to the sign-in of the user after the current transaction commits.
      Parameters:
      user - the affected user, for address and locale
      eventKey - message key naming the event; never a secret
      args - arguments of the event text, such as the number of recovery codes left
